title: Manager / Associate Director – System Protection Engineering (Transmission/Utilities) DFW and Great
description:
TITLE: Manager / Associate Director – System Protection Engineering - (Transmission/Utilities) DFW and Greater Houston
Direct Hire Opportunity
No Sponsorship

POSITION SUMMARY:
Our client, a leading Texas electric transmission and distribution utility, is seeking a Manager / Associate Director – System Protection Engineering to lead the strategic and operational direction of its System Protection organization. This is a leadership role responsible for overseeing engineering standards, protection systems, compliance initiatives, infrastructure modernization projects, and technical operations that support transmission and distribution reliability in a regulated utility environment.
The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in protection and controls engineering, utility infrastructure, NERC compliance, and technical team leadership, and the ability to drive long-term engineering strategy and operational excellence.

IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS:
  • Strong technical expertise within electric utility System Protection / Protection & Controls engineering
  • Experience leading engineering teams and managing technical personnel within a regulated utility environment
  • Deep understanding of relay protection systems, substations, telecommunications, metering, and transmission/distribution systems
  • Strong working knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards and compliance requirements
  • Experience supporting utility capital expansion, modernization, and infrastructure replacement projects.
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering from an accredited university
  • 7+ years of experience within an electric utility environment focused on Protection & Controls / System Protection Engineering
  • Minimum 2 years of leadership or people management experience
  • Strong understanding of transmission and distribution utility systems
  • Working knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards and compliance requirements
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex engineering projects and multiple priorities
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Master's degree in Engineering
Texas Professional Engineer (PE) license
 Experience with protection engineering and testing tools, including:
  • ASPEN OneLiner
  • Doble
  • Omicron
  • Enoserv RTS
  • SEL, Client, and Novatech relay platforms
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Lead the strategic and day-to-day functions of the System Protection Engineering group
  • Oversee engineering activities associated with multiple concurrent utility infrastructure and capital projects
  • Develop and implement protection schemes, relay communication systems, metering, controls, station standards, and line standards
  • Ensure compliance with NERC, IEEE, ASTM, NFPA, and other applicable state and federal regulations
  • Serve as a technical subject matter expert related to system protection and NERC compliance
  • Oversee quality assurance efforts associated with new and existing utility infrastructure projects
  • Develop annual performance objectives, long-term departmental strategy, and operational goals
  • Manage capital, O&M, and E&S budgets associated with the department
  • Recommend and implement improvements to engineering and construction standards
  • Coordinate closely with System Planning, System Engineering, Power Operations, Distribution Operations, and Maintenance teams
  • Represent the organization on engineering, operating, and standards committees
  • Lead, mentor, and develop engineering and technical staff through coaching, performance management, and technical leadership

title: Brand Manager – B2C/Consumer (Dallas/Hybrid)
description:
Title: Brand Manager – Consumer/B2C
Direct Hire Opportunity
No Sponsorship
Hybrid - 3 days Onsite, 2 Days Remote

Our client, a nationally focused consumer organization, is seeking a Brand Manager to join its marketing leadership team in a highly visible, cross-functional role. This individual will help lead and evolve the company's consumer brand strategy across multiple business divisions, markets, and customer touchpoints. This role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, consumer marketing, digital engagement, promotions, and field execution. The ideal candidate will help translate enterprise brand strategy into compelling campaigns, integrated promotions, and consumer experiences that drive engagement, traffic, and long-term brand equity. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants to help shape a modern, evolving brand within a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. The organization is focused on redefining the customer journey and expanding its presence across emerging consumer and social media channels.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in consumer brand marketing and experience supporting multi-location, multi-unit, franchise-style, or distributed operating environments. Candidates from Client, retail, hospitality, restaurant/QSR, or other national consumer brands are highly attractive.

Summary of Skills
  • Strong brand marketing and campaign development experience
  • Experience with CRM managing integrated consumer campaigns across multiple markets/divisions
  • Strong agency management and cross-functional leadership experience
  • Experience balancing national brand consistency with localized execution
  • Strong understanding of modern consumer behavior and social media engagement
  • A strategic mindset paired with hands-on execution capability
  • Strong business acumen, communication skills, and problem-solving ability
Requirements:
  • 7+ years of experience in brand management, integrated marketing, or consumer marketing roles
  • Experience supporting multi-location, franchise-style, or distributed business models preferred
  • Strong background in brand development, promotions, campaign execution, and consumer engagement
  • Proven experience leading external agencies and managing integrated marketing campaigns
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with sales, operations, field teams, and leadership
  • Experience contributing to annual campaign planning, promotional calendars, and go-to-market initiatives
  • Understanding of CRM strategy and customer communication lifecycle management
  • Experience supporting digital marketing initiatives, media campaigns, and social media growth strategies
  • Strong project management and organizational skills within fast-paced environments
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and briefing skills
Preferred Experience:
  • Client, retail, hospitality, restaurant/QSR, or other consumer-facing brand environments
  • Experience supporting influencer marketing or emerging social media channels
  • Exposure to website management, media buying, CRM platforms, or digital asset strategy
  • Experience supporting highly collaborative, geographically distributed organizations

Responsibilities:
  • Help steward and evolve the company's consumer brand strategy across multiple divisions and markets
  • Translate brand strategy into campaign briefs, promotions, and integrated marketing initiatives
  • Lead and manage agency relationships across creative, media, production, and specialty marketing partners
  • Develop and execute consumer-facing campaigns, promotions, and annual communication strategies
  • Partner closely with divisional leadership, sales teams, and marketing stakeholders to align initiatives with business goals
  • Support expansion into emerging consumer and social media channels including influencer marketing initiatives
  • Review and approve creative assets, messaging, and campaign execution to ensure brand consistency
  • Monitor campaign performance and partner with performance marketing teams to optimize results
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, brand consistency, creative effectiveness, and speed-to-market
  • Collaborate on CRM, customer journey, and digital communication initiatives
